summary: Teaching granular synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A source recording (Dye's five built-in samples, or your own WAV) cut into short windowed grains read around a frozen scan position, with grain size, density, spray, a pitch shimmer (micro-pitch wander and octave-up grains) and a grain contour that morphs the window from trapezoid to Gaussian, an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for ambient clouds, frozen textures, glitchy stutters and shimmering pads, or to learn how granular synthesis works.
use_for: A teaching granular synth: ambient clouds, frozen textures and glitchy stutters from grain size, density, spray, octave shimmer and a trapezoid-to-Gaussian contour.

parameters.name: Scan Position
parameters.description: Moves the center playhead location from which audio grains are extracted in the source recording.
parameters.how: Moves the center playhead location from which audio grains are extracted in the source recording.
parameters.sound: Scrubs through different timbral moments of the source audio as if freezing time at that spot.

parameters.name: Grain Size
parameters.description: Sets the duration of each individual audio slice extracted from the buffer.
parameters.how: Sets the duration of each individual audio slice extracted from the buffer.
parameters.sound: Very short grains (< 25 ms) sound buzzy and robotic; long grains (> 150 ms) create smooth, lush ambient clouds.

parameters.name: Density
parameters.description: Controls how many new grains are triggered per second per active voice.
parameters.how: Controls how many new grains are triggered per second per active voice.
parameters.sound: Low density produces sparse, stuttering rhythmic droplets; high density fuses grains into a continuous pad. At most 10 grains overlap per note; beyond that the oldest fade out.

parameters.name: Time Spray
parameters.description: Randomizes each grain's start offset around the main sample_position playhead.
parameters.how: Randomizes each grain's start offset around the main sample_position playhead.
parameters.sound: Eliminates repetitive looping buzz and smears the recording into an organic, non-repeating texture.

parameters.name: Pitch Shimmer
parameters.description: Introduces micro-pitch randomization (up to 25 cents either way) and gradually adds grains pitched +12 semitones (one octave up, up to half of them at 100%).
parameters.how: Introduces micro-pitch randomization (up to 25 cents either way) and gradually adds grains pitched +12 semitones (one octave up, up to half of them at 100%).
parameters.sound: Adds a crystalline, angelic octave glow above ambient pads.

parameters.name: Grain Contour
parameters.description: Morphs the amplitude window of each grain from sharp trapezoid edges (0%) to smooth Gaussian curves (100%).
parameters.how: Morphs the amplitude window of each grain from sharp trapezoid edges (0%) to smooth Gaussian curves (100%).
parameters.sound: Low values sound clicky and glitchy; high values crossfade grains seamlessly without rhythmic transients.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.

imports.description: A WAV sample (mono or stereo, up to 20 s, kept in the machine state): the source the grains are cut from. Item 0. The source can also be one of the built-in samples (kind "source": Choir, Strings, Bell, Pluck or Texture).
